subject: Interim insurance evidence and sourcing plan for MSA/Order Form
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: procurement@greenrivercloud.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: Interim insurance evidence and sourcing plan for MSA/Order Form

Hi Sanjay / GreenRiver procurement —

Thanks for sending over the insurance requirements in the attachment (attached for ease). We’re working through the MSA + Order Form redlines on our side. A couple of quick asks so we can keep this deal moving without blocking procurement:

- Can your broker issue a 30-day interim COI or binder that names "Redwood Inference, Inc." as an additional insured while the endorsement is processed?
- If an endorsement is required to satisfy the "additional insured" language, what is the expected ETA for issuing that endorsement after binding?
- Please confirm the exact naming format you require (entity name + address) and whether waiver of subrogation is mandatory.

To move fast we can accept interim evidence under the following conditions (please confirm):
1) COI lists the required limits in the insurance extract we attached.
2) COI references that an endorsement adding Additional Insured will follow within 21–30 days.
3) Broker provides a cover note or binder and an expected timeline for the endorsement.

I attached the excerpt of GreenRiver’s insurance asks and highlighted the limits (greenriver_insurance_req_v2.pdf). If you can have your broker send a sample COI (or a redlined example) to Megan/me that would help speed legal review.

Proposed next steps:
- Procurement sends sample COI / binder (Megan copied on this thread)
- Redwood legal will confirm whether interim evidence is acceptable and, if so, under what conditions
- We’ll document acceptance in HubSpot and proceed to signature on Order Form once evidence is in place

We need to avoid holding signature for an extra procurement cycle — any flexibility you can give on accepting interim evidence will help.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Hi Naomi / Sanjay —

We can absolutely issue a 30-day binder/COI that reflects the limits and includes a note that an endorsement adding Redwood Inference, Inc. will follow. A couple of clarifying items from our side:

- Please confirm the exact entity name and address to appear on the COI / endorsement. Suggested format: "Redwood Inference, Inc., 1000 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103".
- Do you require the COI to explicitly say "Additional Insured" on the face, or is the broker's cover note + follow-up endorsement acceptable? Some carriers only add Additional Insured via endorsement.
- Waiver of subrogation: we need a yes/no — some carriers charge extra or require carrier approval.

ETA: if we bind today we can issue an interim COI within 48 hours and then route the endorsement for signature; endorsement turnaround typically 10–21 business days depending on carrier. We can expedite to 7–10 business days for prioritized accounts but will need confirmation in writing that interim COI is acceptable for signature.

Attached is a quick visual of the sample COI we’d send (sample_coi_redline.png). If Redwood legal can confirm acceptance of a binder + endorsement-to-follow approach (and specify the maximum allowable endorsement turnaround), we’ll proceed.

Cheers,
Megan Li
Senior Broker, Acme Insurance Partners
megan.li@acmebrokers.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Megan Li <megan.li@acmebrokers.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@greenrivercloud.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:06:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Interim insurance evidence and sourcing plan for MSA/Order Form

Folks — forwarding procurement + broker reply. Quick ask from legal: can we accept a 30-day COI / binder that references an endorsement to follow, provided that the endorsement is delivered within a fixed window and we retain remedies if it isn’t?

Suggested conditions for acceptance (draft — please redline):
- We accept a binder/COI that meets the stated policy limits and includes a cover note stating an Additional Insured endorsement will be issued within 21 calendar days of binder date.
- Acceptance is contingent on GreenRiver (or their broker) posting the endorsement to our shared Drive and confirming by email.
- If endorsement is not received within 30 days, Redwood may treat the absence as a material breach permitting contract suspension of performance until evidence is provided.

Aditya / Kimberly: can you confirm whether the above is sufficient or whether we require modifications to the Order Form language (e.g., explicit conditional acceptance clause)? Also flag any material risk (carrier denial, retro-dating concerns, etc.).

Thanks — I’d like to avoid delaying signature beyond week of Feb 22.

— Naomi

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Megan Li <megan.li@acmebrokers.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@greenrivercloud.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Interim insurance evidence and sourcing plan for MSA/Order Form

Thanks Naomi — reviewed. Legal is generally comfortable with accepting an interim COI/binder + endorsement-to-follow, provided we impose clear conditions to mitigate exposure. Recommended final language and controls:

1) Interim evidence accepted: COI/binder must reflect the minimum limits listed in the attached GreenRiver requirements and include a cover note that an Additional Insured endorsement will be issued and mailed/emailed to Redwood within 21 calendar days from the binder issue date.

2) Verification: Broker must upload the final endorsement to our shared Drive and notify procurement/legal. The uploaded document must be an endorsement form (not just a carrier note) and must not be retro-dated to before the binder date.

3) Remedies: If the endorsement is not delivered within 30 calendar days, Redwood may (a) suspend performance of the Order Form until evidence is provided, and/or (b) charge back any incremental insurance-related cost if Redwood had to procure third-party coverage.

4) Naming: COI/endorsement must name exactly: "Redwood Inference, Inc.; 1000 Market St; San Francisco, CA 94103". If GreenRiver requires variation, procurement must obtain prior written legal approval.

5) Waiver of subrogation: only required if carrier confirms in writing it applies with the endorsement — otherwise not a precondition for signature.

If procurement is comfortable with these controls, we can document acceptance in the Order Form (conditional evidence clause) and proceed to countersignature. If broker can commit to 7–10 business days for endorsement, that would be ideal; otherwise proceed with 21-day expectation and the remedies above.

Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
